properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-26 (root-cause skill): an act owed by an outside party can be pieced together from five existing records, but no one record says who owes what by when and no read reports it as owed by them; a designer filed such acts as planned checks
properties.statement: SYMPTOM (a designer agent on a sample shop design, flo2.io, reflow2 0.92.0): "There is no way to record an owed action by an outside party; I used planned checks instead." Its record: a Verification (method review, status planned) named "OWED (county hearings examiner, through the CUP; the owner applies) ...", VERIFIES the ADU component, who and what only in prose, no date. CANDIDATES. (a) the vocabulary has a record for it and the designer missed it: REFUTED as a whole, CONFIRMED in parts. Measured in v0.92.0 schema: Contributor kind `organization` exists; OWNED_BY (* to Contributor) exists but loop_status reads it only as "gaps on your ground" (report.rs ~1066); Question.asked_of names a Contributor but a Question is a question with no due date; SCHEDULED_FOR (Verification/Requirement/... to DesignEpoch/Release, modality required) gives a deadline only as an epoch; GATED_ON is TRL/MRL only; Actor has no edge meaning "owes"; a follow-up TemporalFact is our own to-do. (b) the reading is wrong, a planned Verification IS the right home: PARTLY; an authority's ruling is a check on compliance, but an engineer's deferred submittal is an act that PRODUCES something, and a planned check reads in coverage/evidence as "never ran" rather than "waiting on the county". (c) OUTSIDE reflow2, flo2 has a place for it: NOT FOUND, a search of flo2's design for outside-party actions returned nothing relevant. CLASS: a design that reaches outside itself (permits, utilities, engineers) has no first-class record of what it waits on from others, so closure and loop reads cannot tell "we owe it" from "they owe it"; the idea dec:idea-an-outside-part-is-marked-as-outside-and-an-outside-party-is-a-consumer anticipated the party, not the act. NOT ESTABLISHED: how often this arises outside building designs; whether convention (a) in the new idea suffices without a new edge. No cause node is drawn: nothing broke, the record was never designed. RECOMMENDED: the owner chooses among the options in dec:idea-an-action-owed-by-an-outside-party-is-recorded-with-who-and-by-when; the most correct is the one with a READER (loop_status and closure_report list owed-outside acts with who and due), whatever the encoding.
